info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-List Facility Site Operations-spec
info.description: The Facility Site Operations Retrieval API provides businesses with comprehensive access to operational data related to various facility sites. This API enables users to efficiently query site operations, offering critical insights that can aid in decision-making and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include facility managers, operational analysts, and financial institutions seeking to monitor and optimize site performance. With this API, organizations can effectively track and analyze facility operations, facilitating enhanced resource planning and operational management.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve a list of site operations related to facilities. It provides essential details necessary for managing and monitoring site activities effectively.

requestBody.description: Contains the parameters required to retrieve site operations for the facilities. This request body enables the consumer to specify necessary filters and options needed for the operation.

200.description: Request completed successfully, returning the list of site operations.

ListFacilitySiteOperationsRequest.description: A JSON representation of the request body for the GET operation on site operations.

items.description: A list of operations for various sites, including details such as asset and work order IDs.

sort.description: Sorting criteria applied to the operations list.

ListFacilitySiteOperationsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the GET operations on site facilities, providing a list of site-related operations and their respective details.

assetId.description: Unique identifier for the asset related to the operation.

workOrderId.description: Unique identifier for the work order associated with the operation.

scheduledDate.description: The date when the operation is scheduled.

vendorId.description: Unique identifier for the vendor responsible for the operation.

facilityZone.description: Zone within the facility where the operation is taking place.

estimatedDurationMinutes.description: Estimated duration of the operation in minutes.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the operation record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of when the operation record was last updated.

OperationItem.description: Details of an individual operation item within a site facility.

page.description: Current page number in the pagination.

totalItems.description: Total number of items available across all pages.

Pagination.description: Pagination details for the response, including page number, page size, and total items count.

correlationId.description: Correlation identifier for tracking the request across systems.

generatedAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the response was generated.

processingRegion.description: Region where the data processing occurred.

Metadata.description: Metadata information for the response, providing context for the operation results.

X-Endpoint-Id.description: A unique identifier for the endpoint that processed the request.

X-Runtime-App.description: The name of the application that handled the request, providing insight into the backend services used.

bearerAuth.description: This security scheme uses a Bearer Authentication with JSON Web Tokens (JWT). Clients are required to include a valid token in the Authorization header of the request in order to authenticate.
